chunks: There, Zachariah prayed to his Lord, saying: 'O Lord, grant me from Yourself virtuous offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Zachariah pray for in the Quran?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Zachariah (Zakariya) supplicates for a virtuous offspring despite his old age and his wife's barrenness, highlighting the Shia emphasis on divine responsiveness to sincere du'a. The phrase 'from Yourself' (min ladunka) underscores the direct bestowal of grace, a concept often linked in Shia exegesis to the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt. This narrative serves as a foundational precedent for the miraculous nature of prophetic lineage in Islamic theology.
